note: Both sets correctly capture the baseline apertures, instrument counts, Lynx focal length and the 52 m starshade, and both omit Lynx's three science instruments. Set A is cleaner: its 16 claims are all supported and consistently carry the baseline-mission condition, with only mild redundancy between diameter and aperture phrasings. Set B adds two duplicate claims, and one of them (HabEx instrument count quoted only as "four science instruments") is a fragment that does not bind to HabEx since LUVOIR-A also has four; Set B also drops the baseline condition on a few claims and leaves the starshade entity unbound to HabEx. Coverage of distinct facts is otherwise equal, so Set A wins on fewer trivial or weakly supported claims.
